scripts.dev:local: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.d1:local: wrangler d1 execute smartweb-db --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute smartweb-db --local --file=seed.sql
scripts.d1:remote: wrangler d1 execute smartweb-db --remote --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute smartweb-db --remote --file=seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=rstk-catalogo
